clue.text: Smarten up SA quartet, looking at art in London?

indicators.note: something looking at you holds you in view, taken here as one piece wrapping around another

parts.note: the Tate is London's famous group of art galleries
SA, sex appeal, is IT in crosswords
a quartet is four, IV in Roman numerals

explanation.surface: Someone tidies up a South African foursome before an outing to a London gallery.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface suggests a South African quartet visiting a gallery; SA is the crossword shorthand for sex appeal, and 'looking at' is the container signal.
explanation.definitionFit: To titivate is to make small improvements to one's appearance, a synonym of smartening up.

clue.text: Partisan leader put it on bottles …

indicators.note: a container bottles its contents, so these words hold the answer inside them

explanation.surface: A guerrilla chief tells someone to label the bottles.
explanation.definitionFit: Tito led the Yugoslav Partisans, the resistance army fighting the Axis in the Second World War.

clue.text: … whose overthrow is a problem for auditors

indicators.note: overthrowing turns something upside down, so the leader's name is read backwards

parts.note: the ellipsis carries on from the previous clue, so whose stands for that clue's answer, the partisan leader

explanation.surface: Toppling the partisan leader causes trouble for those listening.
explanation.walkthrough: Auditors here are listeners, not accountants, which is why an ear inflammation troubles them.
explanation.definitionFit: Otitis is inflammation of the ear, an affliction for anyone trying to hear.

clue.text: Transport organisation will pound city

parts.note: BR is British Rail, the former UK national railway
'is to' expresses the future, as in 'he is to go', so it can stand for will
L is the abbreviation for a pound sterling

explanation.surface: A transport body threatens to batter a city.
explanation.walkthrough: BR is British Rail, the old nationalised UK railway; BRISTOL is a city in south-west England.
explanation.definitionFit: Bristol is a port city in south-west England.

clue.text: The large woman is nastiest suspect

indicators.note: something suspect is dodgy or not right, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A big woman is under suspicion as the cruellest of all.
explanation.definitionFit: A titaness is a female Titan, one of the giant deities of Greek myth, so a huge woman.

clue.text: Pardon the request for it getting on a little bit charged

parts.note: RE means on or about, as in a letter heading
petit is French for little
an ion is a charged particle

explanation.surface: Asking pardon for something taking on a small electrical charge.
explanation.walkthrough: Saying 'Pardon?' asks someone to say it again; 'getting' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: When you say 'Pardon?' you are asking the speaker to say something again.

clue.text: Pain rescuing 9 if timely?

definitions.meaning: a sharp pain in the side, as after running
the proverb says a small sewing repair made in time saves nine later

explanation.definitionFit: A stitch is a sudden side ache, and the proverb 'a stitch in time saves nine' praises a prompt repair.

clue.text: Order head one to enter church

indicators.note: one piece entering another goes inside it

parts.note: a minster is a large church, like York Minster
one is I as a Roman numeral

explanation.surface: Someone is told to go into church.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Order' looks like a command, but it is a religious order.
explanation.definitionFit: In some religious orders, such as the Franciscans, the superior is titled minister.

clue.text: Think fish swallowed

parts.note: the ide is a freshwater fish
swallowed means ate

explanation.surface: Someone muses on a fish they have gulped down.
explanation.definitionFit: To ideate is to form ideas, so to think.

clue.text: Artist tipped over the edge by love

indicators.note: tipped over means turned over, so the word is read backwards

parts.note: a rim is an edge
love is zero in tennis, the letter O

explanation.surface: A painter is driven mad by romance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'tipped over' reverses RIM to MIR; Joan Miro was a Spanish painter.
explanation.definitionFit: Joan Miro was a Spanish surrealist painter.

clue.text: More than one will put a couple forward in accounts

indicators.note: a couple is two, so a pair of letters is moved to the front

parts.note: accounts are financial statements

explanation.surface: Wills that bring forward a pair of names in the accounts.
explanation.walkthrough: 'put a couple forward' moves the TE of STATEMENTS to the front.
explanation.definitionFit: A testament is a legal will, so the plural means several wills.

clue.text: American Navy in Turkish city?

parts.note: tars are sailors, the men of a navy

explanation.surface: The US Navy turns up in a city in Turkey.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark admits Tarsus is in Turkey, though not a big city today; 'in' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: Tarsus is an ancient city in southern Turkey, birthplace of St Paul.

clue.text: This translation is visible: forward it to lecturer in claim

indicators.note: one piece goes in the other

parts.note: to sue is to make a legal claim
forward means cheeky, pert

explanation.surface: Someone presses a lecturer to see the translation as part of a claim.
explanation.definitionFit: A supertitle is a translation projected above the stage at an opera, so the audience can see it.

clue.text: The number quaffing Mother's Ruin, knocking back this, stand?

indicators.note: knocking back a drink tips it up, so everything is read backwards
quaffing takes a drink inside, so one piece holds the other

parts.note: Mother's Ruin is a nickname for gin

explanation.surface: Drinking gin and knocking it back before a casual fling.
explanation.walkthrough: 'quaffing' wraps THE NO round the gin, and 'knocking back' turns the whole run around; the definition fills the blank before 'stand'.
explanation.definitionFit: A one-night stand is a brief sexual encounter, so this fills the blank before stand.

clue.text: Particular regard

definitions.meaning: a detail, as in 'in every particular'

explanation.definitionFit: Respect means a detail or point, as in 'in this respect', and also esteem.

clue.text: Restrained style has time in Paris, perhaps

indicators.note: one piece goes in the other

parts.note: Paris is an example of a city

explanation.surface: Elegance with time to spare in a French capital.
explanation.definitionFit: Chastity is restraint, purity of manner or style.

clue.text: Striving endlessly for pain relief

indicators.note: without its end, so the final letter goes

parts.note: striving means aspiring

explanation.surface: Someone tries constantly to stop the pain.
explanation.definitionFit: Aspirin is a common painkiller.

clue.text: For ego, I leave an impression with Yard, restraining appeal

indicators.note: holding in, so one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: to dent is to leave a mark
sex appeal is IT in crosswords

explanation.surface: An egotist makes a mark at Scotland Yard while holding back an appeal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'For' and 'with' are link words; 'restraining' is the container signal, holding the appeal inside the rest.
explanation.definitionFit: Ego is the sense of self, one's identity.

clue.text: Perfume company boxing No. 5, say?

indicators.note: boxing something puts it inside a box, so one piece holds the other

parts.note: Chanel is a perfume house
N is short for number

explanation.surface: A perfume house packaging its famous No. 5 scent.
explanation.walkthrough: Chanel No. 5 is the scent the surface evokes, but 5 is Channel 5, a UK TV channel.
explanation.definitionFit: Channel 5 is a British television station, an example of a TV broadcaster's band.

clue.text: Disordered chap holding sailing boat near

indicators.note: one piece holds the other inside
disordered means jumbled, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: a proa is a Malay sailing boat

explanation.surface: A messy man clutching a yacht comes close.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Disordered' rearranges CHAP into APCH; 'near' is a verb here, meaning to come close.
explanation.definitionFit: To approach is to come close, a synonym of near as a verb.

clue.text: One canonised sent to Hell with age taking its toll?…

indicators.note: sent to a place means put in it, so one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: the pit is hell
one canonised is a saint, A ST

explanation.surface: A saint consigned to hell as age catches up with them.
explanation.walkthrough: A ST, 'a saint', goes inside PIT.
explanation.definitionFit: Being past it means too old to do what one once did, which is age taking its toll.

clue.text: Playwright who doesn't do things by halves?

definitions.text: who doesn't do things by halves?
definitions.meaning: a drinker who orders pints, not half-pints

explanation.definitionFit: Harold Pinter was a British dramatist; jokily, a pint-drinker scorns half measures of beer.

clue.text: … with vocalic change, an office reminder?

indicators.note: a change of vowel swaps one vowel for another in the previous answer

parts.note: the ellipsis carries on from the clue before, standing for that clue's answer, the phrase for being too old

explanation.surface: A sticky note made from the previous answer by swapping a vowel.
explanation.walkthrough: The ellipsis links to the previous clue: change its answer's A to O.
explanation.definitionFit: A Post-it is a small sticky note used as a reminder in offices.

clue.text: Helps fool with current name in figures

parts.note: an ass is a fool
I is the symbol for electric current

indicators.note: one piece goes in the other

parts.note: stats are figures, statistics

explanation.surface: Aid from a fool with an electrical name among the statistics.
explanation.definitionFit: Helps as a plural noun means helpers or aides.

clue.text: Get her removed from totally as a singer

indicators.note: one piece is taken out of the other

parts.note: totally means altogether
the letters of these words as written

explanation.surface: Someone wants her taken out of the choir entirely.
explanation.definitionFit: An alto is a singer with a low female or high male voice.

clue.text: Single tweeter working

parts.note: single means one, the article A
a tit is a small songbird, which tweets

explanation.surface: A lone bird busy at work.
explanation.definitionFit: Being at it means busily engaged in something.

clue.text: Quarters a log for fuel

explanation.definitionFit: A billet is lodging for troops, and also a chunk of wood for burning.

clue.text: Reworking is second title pick? They think they are

indicators.note: reworking something rearranges it, so these letters are reordered

explanation.surface: Rearranging a title to pick a winner, as snobs believe they are the best.
explanation.walkthrough: Elitists think they are the pick, meaning the best.
explanation.definitionFit: Elitists believe themselves part of the elite, the choicest few.
